info.title: Artifact Gateway Native Hosted Management API
info.description: Resolved management and native protocol contract for Artifact Gateway 0.2.

get.description: Repository administrator reads the independent default-disabled quarantine read policy.

put.description: Current repository administrator replaces the policy using version CAS and transactional audit. Same-state current-version requests are unaudited no-ops. Enabled policies consistently hide quarantined compact and legacy indexes, quick gemspecs and original GET/HEAD bytes before ETag/304 or Range handling. Policy read failures deny access. Yank remains effective regardless of policy.

post.description: Creates a bounded, durable Hosted-to-Hosted replication plan. This default-disabled preview fixes strict chart identities, complete chart/provenance SHA-256 and sizes, and source governance versions. Provenance digest/size must both describe the same optional closure (empty/zero when absent). Each chart commits atomically; a failed batch retains completed items. No credentials, source object keys, Proxy or Group targets are accepted. The current durable actor, source read and target write authority, governance and capacity are checked again by the worker at publication.

get.description: Repository administrator reads the exact retained gem variant, including yanked and quarantined publications. The package-name grant and current credential are checked.

post.description: Repository administrator compares the immutable digest and governance version. Yank hides the exact version/platform from every index, gemspec and download. Restore verifies complete original bytes, archive identity and metadata before rechecking current authority and atomically committing state and audit. A current same-state request is an unaudited no-op; a stale version conflicts. Retained identity and capacity are not released by yank or quarantine. Release verifies original bytes, digest and identity before clearing only quarantine; restore clears only yank. Replayed pushes cannot clear either restriction.

delete.description: Yank one immutable Hosted version/platform using the official gem client form. An absent or empty platform means ruby; other variants remain visible. All indexes, gemspecs, original downloads and conditional reads hide the yanked gem. The original bytes, identity and capacity remain retained. Current package-name write authority is rechecked after the publication lock; same-state replay is idempotent. Unknown or repeated form fields, including ruby_abi, are rejected.

put.description: Gateway-specific publication API, not a native helm push or ChartMuseum endpoint. Upload one chart and optional provenance as a single immutable closure. Chart.yaml name/version must equal the path; chart filename must be name-version.tgz and provenance name-version.tgz.prov. The provenance must contain the same chart metadata and full chart SHA-256; publisher trust is verified separately by Helm using a consumer-owned public keyring. Gateway does not import private keys or assert signature trust. Exact closure replay is idempotent; changing chart, provenance or its absence returns 409. Objects are read back and verified before transaction commit. Pending uploads never appear in the index.

put.description: Stages one immutable verified object in the publisher's one-hour session. conanmanifest.txt is the visibility signal: validates every declared MD5 tree entry, hash revision and package identity, then atomically commits revision metadata, session state and a publish audit for the actual commit caller, using the same validator and commit boundary as management publication. The session version fences concurrent staged-pointer changes. Repeating identical bytes preserves the visible identity; changed bytes conflict. Limits are 1 GiB per object and expanded tree including tar framing, 1 MiB manifest/conaninfo and 4096 manifest/archive entries. Sessions do not expose partial revisions. Applies existing quota, scan and quarantine.

get.description: Administrators only. Lists durable schedules; nextRunAt is the next eligible UTC occurrence, not a promise that capacity or a worker is available.

post.description: Administrators only. Freeze the source version, mappings and native policy from a successfully completed batch. Each occurrence fully re-enumerates using the existing durable batch worker. One pending operator capacity observation is consumed once; missing or expired observations cause waiting_capacity. There is no trusted remote object-pool observer. Restart and missed intervals coalesce to one due occurrence; no backlog or browser timer is used. A stopped plan cannot resume. Genuine unsupported payloads, SNAPSHOT, missing required artifacts and source drift reject a template. Exact regenerated Maven metadata may remain as separately reported unsupported entries.

Administrator-only Nexus 3 read-only source. Credentials are encrypted using GATEWAY_SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY; responses and audits never include them. No source writes or target mutations occur. Exhausts asset pagination for selected supported Hosted repositories with bounded requests (128), response bytes (16 MiB total, 2 MiB per response), repositories (500) and time (30 seconds). Cyclic tokens, untrusted download URLs and exhausted budgets fail explicitly without partial success. Proxy/Group/unknown formats and Maven SNAPSHOT repositories are explicitly unsupported for asset discovery. MIXED repositories return release-version paths; SNAPSHOT paths, shared metadata and unclassifiable Maven paths are listed explicitly in unsupportedAssets. Budgets count both supported and unsupported assets.

Administrator-only Nexus 3 read-only source. Credentials are encrypted using GATEWAY_SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY; responses and audits never include them. No source writes or target mutations occur. Validates explicit native target names, formats/types, existing-name conflicts and ordered Group member mappings. Re-reads source configuration; performs no target writes. Permissions, credentials and source-specific fields require manual reconfiguration.

delete.description: Disables the repository. Requires repository `admin` scope, because stopping reads and writes for every client is a repository-administration action rather than a content mutation; a `write` scope is not sufficient.

patch.description: Updates repository configuration. Requires repository `admin` scope, because endpoint, allowlist, egress, upstream credential, anonymous-read, and strict-publication settings change how the repository behaves for every client; a `write` scope is not sufficient.

Creates or replaces a single grant identified by its principal and resource prefix, leaving every other grant of the repository untouched. Unlike replaceGrants no If-Match is required, because the write is confined to one grant row and cannot clobber concurrent changes to other principals. Returns the full grant list with the new version, exactly like replaceGrants.

delete.description: Removes a single grant identified by principal and optional resource prefix, leaving every other grant of the repository untouched. Answers 404 when no such grant exists, so a console working from a stale list learns the row is already gone. The parameters deliberately carry no length cap beyond a non-empty principal, because the request only has to name a stored row and a row written by an earlier revision must stay removable even when its key is longer than today's write rules allow.

/repositories/{repositoryId}/quarantine-.description:
Versioned, default-off read enforcement for supported Hosted formats.
For APT Hosted, quarantined pool GET/HEAD and complete signed metadata views
containing that package return 403, including retired by-hash views.
Signed bytes are never filtered or rewritten on read. Release restores access
only to existing lifecycle references and never reverses deletion.

post.summary: Create or replay an immutable artifact replication plan
post.description:
Newly accepted plans persist both the immutable source coordinate and
digest; neither field may be present without the other. A request-time
quarantine denial returns 403 without creating a plan. If the final
worker check instead observes quarantine, it parks the existing plan
without publishing target metadata. After release, replaying the exact
request with the same Idempotency-Key requeues and returns that plan; it
does not create a second plan. A PyPI source version whose file membership
changes after enqueue is likewise parked with
`replication_snapshot_changed`; exact replay atomically refreshes that
plan's checkpoints before requeueing the same plan ID.

200.description:
Replication plans involving this repository. Coordinate and digest
are both present for current plans and both absent only on historical
plans created before immutable identity persistence was introduced.

Replication plan and checkpoint progress for this repository.
Coordinate and digest are both present for current plans and both
absent only on historical plans created before immutable identity
persistence was introduced. A new worker fails closed rather than
publishing a non-terminal historical plan with both fields absent.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending or failed replication plan
delete.description:
Stops a pending or failed replication plan from being claimed again. A
running plan cannot be cancelled because the worker owns it mid-flight;
such a request fails with 409. Completed and already-cancelled plans are
also not cancellable. The plan record is retained for audit.

get.description: Returns Raw bytes for a file path. `.sha256` and `.sha512` suffixes return a derived lowercase hexadecimal checksum plus newline. When the catch-all path ends in `/`, it instead returns a lexicographically ordered listing of visible Hosted assets below that canonical prefix; `n` and `last` control pagination. With an `uploadId`, returns no content and the current Upload-Offset for an open resumable upload rather than artifact bytes. File GET supports a single Range or bounded multipart/byteranges from one immutable object. A Range field accepts at most 8192 bytes and 16 intervals; overlapping, duplicate and adjacent intervals coalesce in ascending order. Valid unsatisfiable intervals are omitted if another interval is satisfiable. Multipart payload is limited to 64 MiB, with at most 32 KiB of framing; these aggregate limits do not restrict a single coalesced interval. Malformed fields, multiple Range field lines, no satisfiable intervals or exceeded limits return 416. A strong matching If-Range enables Range; weak, date or non-matching validators return the full object. Cold Proxy GET fetches and verifies the complete object before applying local ranges; Range and client validators are never forwarded to the upstream.

put.description:
Standard Raw Hosted write. The request body is stored as immutable verified content and the canonical Raw path is atomically created or replaced; no management publish session is used for Raw. A `.sha256` or `.sha512` target validates that checksum against an existing primary object and returns no content without storing a sidecar asset. With `uploadId` and `complete=1`, appends any final bytes, requires a `Digest: sha-256=<base64>` header, and atomically publishes the resumable upload.
If-Match and If-None-Match (RFC 9110) make a primary-path write or a resumable completion conditional. The Gateway re-evaluates them in the same lock or transaction that replaces the path reference, so of two writers holding the same validator only one succeeds. `If-None-Match: *` creates only when the path has no current asset; `If-Match: *` replaces only an existing asset; an entity-tag list compares against the current digest, accepting both the `"sha256-<hex>"` tag reads return and the `"sha256:<hex>"` tag writes return. If-Match uses strong comparison, so a weak tag never matches. A failed condition answers 412 without the current validator and stores nothing; a failed resumable completion leaves the upload open. If-Unmodified-Since cannot be evaluated atomically and is rejected with 400. A request without these headers keeps the unconditional replacement behavior.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: `*` or a comma-separated list of entity tags the current path reference must match (strong comparison).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: `*` for create-only, or a comma-separated list of entity tags the current path reference must not match (weak comparison).

400.description: Malformed If-Match or If-None-Match, or an unsupported If-Unmodified-Since precondition; nothing is stored

412.description: The current path reference does not satisfy If-Match or If-None-Match; the reference is unchanged and a resumable upload stays open

authorizationReason.description: Optional bounded authorization decision reason. Current values include scope_not_granted and grant_lookup_failed; consumers must accept future bounded values.

evidence.description: Optional immutable, operation-specific evidence. Keys and values are bounded strings; consumers must accept future keys.

HelmPreviewUpstreamAuth.description: Write-only source credential sealed independently of local client credentials; a changed source binding requires a fresh secret or explicit none

publicationApi.description: Explicit Gateway multipart publication API template, present only for Hosted

HelmPreviewChart.description: Index metadata declares an expected digest; byte counts and provenance are known only after a complete closure has been verified and cached

cached.description: True only for a complete verified chart/provenance closure; false for index metadata without verified bytes

provenanceUrl.description: Present only when the closure contains provenance

lastSuccessfulAt.description: Most recent fully verified batch within the plan-supported native content scope. Exact regenerated Maven metadata remains in original unsupported details and counts; this is not complete-source clearance or client-cutover evidence.

NexusMigrationScanFailure.description: Last failed scan diagnostic. No partial inventory is made executable. Empty asset fields identify failure before an individual asset was known; sourceRepositories bounds the selected repository scope. Contains no upstream URL or credential.

transferredBytes.description: Copy-stage source bytes actually read, including retries and revalidation of existing identities. Separate from pre-copy sourceVerificationBytes; neither counter implies target visibility.

sourceVerificationBytes.description: Actual source bytes read to fill missing manifest hashes during source verification, separately persisted even if the scan fails. Discovery-provided required hashes avoid this transfer.

mediaType.description: Verified source OCI manifest media type, frozen with the immutable asset. Omitted for other assets.

baseUrl.description: HTTPS Nexus instance origin and optional context path. User info, query and fragment are rejected.

recipient.description: Required at creation. Omit on update to retain the encrypted recipient.

OCIDiscoveryProfile.description: Gateway OCI discovery API support, independent of any upstream's enumeration coverage. Each Catalog/Referrers response reports its actual coverage or an explicit unsupported/error response. Verified content digests do not establish signer trust.

catalog.description: Supports authorized, bounded Catalog snapshots, including Proxy and Group sources.

referrers.description: Supports OCI 1.1 Referrers API discovery and validated subject/artifact content from one bound source.

tagFallback.description: Supports the referrers tag schema fallback. Currently false.

signatureVerification.description: Verifies signature identity and trust policy. Currently false; digest/subject validation alone does not verify the signer.

version.description: Exact package version when the format exposes one independently from the coordinate.

versionCount.description: Number of versions represented by a package-level browse result.

cachedAt.description: Most recent successful cache fill or metadata revalidation time.

sourceUrl.description: Exact upstream URL persisted when this proxy asset was cached.

buildNumber.description: Local publication sequence for Maven SNAPSHOT cursors; zero for releases. Imported source identity is exposed separately.

publisher.description: Publisher actor when the format records it.

sourceTimestamp.description: Original timestamp of an imported Maven SNAPSHOT; absent for ordinary publications.

sourceBuildNumber.description: Original imported Maven SNAPSHOT build number, which can repeat at different timestamps.

matchKind.description: Whether this result matched a coordinate or an exact digest.

match.description: Actual coordinate match mode for this hit; omitted for exact digests. Cargo legacy coordinate hits use contains.

searchedRepositories.description: Number of readable active repositories considered by this query.

EgressProxy.description: Per-Proxy-Repository egress network proxy configuration. Only meaningful when the repository type is proxy. `password` is accepted on write (plaintext over TLS) and stored AES-256-GCM encrypted; responses never return it and carry `credentialsConfigured` instead.

mode.description: direct bypasses any proxy (keeping private-address protection); environment follows process HTTP(S)_PROXY/NO_PROXY; custom uses the per-repository proxy below.

protocol.description: Custom proxy protocol. http uses CONNECT; socks5 supports optional remote DNS.

host.description: Custom proxy hostname or IP, without scheme or credentials.

password.description: Optional proxy authentication password. Write-only; stored encrypted. Omit on update to keep stored credentials.

clearCredentials.description: When true on update, removes any stored proxy credentials.

remoteDns.description: socks5 only. When true the proxy resolves the upstream hostname (socks5h); when false the gateway resolves locally and keeps the private-address check.

noProxy.description: Upstream host suffixes or CIDR ranges that bypass the custom proxy and connect directly. Matched against the upstream host, never the proxy host.

credentialsConfigured.description: True when encrypted proxy credentials are stored.

UpstreamAuth.description: Protected upstream credentials for Go, Maven, OCI, npm, PyPI, Cargo, APT, Raw and Conan Proxy repositories. Basic or Bearer authentication targets the bound upstream. Conan exchanges Basic credentials through its users/authenticate endpoint before reading protected metadata or files. When OCI ociBearer is configured, these credentials are sent only to its bound issuer and content requests use the exchanged pull token. Cross-origin redirects strip credentials. Rotation or clear invalidates credential-bound content and token caches. Changing the upstream URL or OCI issuer binding requires a fresh secret or scheme none; stored credentials are never implicitly rebound to a new destination. Hosted repositories and unsupported formats reject this field. `secret` is accepted on write over TLS and stored AES-256-GCM encrypted; responses never return it and carry `credentialsConfigured` instead.

scheme.description: none removes any stored credential and reads the upstream anonymously; basic authenticates with an HTTP Basic credential (Conan exchanges it for a source token); bearer sends `Authorization - Bearer <secret>`.

username.description: basic only. Upstream account name. Rejected for bearer.

secret.description: Upstream password or token. Write-only; stored encrypted. Omit on update to keep the stored secret only while its scheme and upstream destination binding are unchanged. Both schemes require a secret, so clear a stored credential by setting scheme to none rather than sending an empty secret.

credentialsConfigured.description: True when an encrypted upstream credential is stored.

OCIBearer.description: Optional upstream Bearer challenge exchange for OCI Proxy repositories. Without this configuration content requests use the explicit upstreamAuth setting. The realm and service bind the approved issuer and audience. With this configuration upstreamAuth credentials are sent only to the bound issuer; this object contains no credentials or cached tokens. It does not add the realm to allowedHosts or grant network access. A cross-origin realm still needs explicit permission under the existing egress policy. On update omit the field to preserve it, or send null to clear it. Setting an object replaces both fields together. Hosted and other formats reject this property, including null. Changing this binding while protected upstream credentials are configured requires a fresh upstreamAuth.secret or upstreamAuth.scheme none in the same request.

realm.description: Exact complete HTTPS token-service URL. The first exchange contract rejects userinfo, all query parameters, and fragments.

service.description: Exact challenge audience. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes; no whitespace or control characters.

UpdateRepository.description: Editable repository management policy and proxy configuration. Hosted repositories accept anonymousRead updates and Maven Hosted repositories also accept mavenStrictPublication updates; name, format, and type are immutable after creation.

endpoint.description: Upstream base URL (https). Required for proxy repositories.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts the proxy may egress to. Required for raw, conan, and npm proxies. npm tarball redirects are limited to this list.

anonymousRead.description: Anonymous read policy. Defaults to false and permits unauthenticated protocol GET/HEAD where effective policy allows it.

mavenStrictPublication.description: Maven Hosted only. False publishes successful standard PUTs directly; true requires a Gateway coordinate commit before reads can resolve the uploaded coordinate.

EgressProxyTestResult.description: Ephemeral result of an egress proxy connection test. Nothing is persisted.

proxyHost.description: Custom proxy host (no credentials) when mode is custom.

upstreamStatus.description: HTTP status returned by the upstream probe, when reached.

error.description: Sanitized failure reason when reachable is false.

QuarantineReadPolicy.description: Hosted repository policy controlling protocol reads of quarantined artifacts. It is disabled by default.

aptTargetSuite.description: Required only for APT Hosted operator preview. Appends the immutable pool package to this target suite using the target signer. The pool coordinate preserves its component.

artifactScanning.description: True when a scanner is configured for this repository format and its assets can be resolved.

publicationScanning.description: True when new publications in this repository can automatically enqueue scanner jobs.

resource.description: Concrete canonical resource evaluated for prefix-scoped grants; empty means repository-wide access.

simulated.description: True when an administrator supplied an actor instead of evaluating the authenticated caller.

resolutionOrder.description: Order among members visible to this reader, Hosted first.

sourceTimestamp.description: Original timestamp of an imported Maven SNAPSHOT; absent for ordinary publications.

sourceBuildNumber.description: Original imported Maven SNAPSHOT build number, which can repeat at different timestamps.

id.description: Server-issued opaque node ID. Submit it unchanged as parent.

name.description: Format-aware display name for this level.

path.description: Canonical Repository-relative asset path when the node represents a path.

cachedAt.description: Last update of the live verified cache index, for Proxy assets only.

buildNumber.description: Exact local Maven SNAPSHOT publication sequence; Proxy nodes additionally pin the timestamp in their opaque ID. Imported source identity is exposed separately.

sourceRepositoryId.description: Repository providing this publication or cached upstream response; absent on aggregate Group nodes.

cacheState.description: Present only for a Proxy asset backed by a live positive cache index. This is not a lifecycle Artifact Identity.

sources.description: Ordered local contributions for a Group node. Does not identify an actual protocol hit.

cacheRepositoryName.description: Scope owning the cache index, which may be a Group rather than the source Repository.

sourceTimestamp.description: Original timestamp of an imported Maven SNAPSHOT; absent for ordinary publications.

sourceBuildNumber.description: Original imported Maven SNAPSHOT build number, which can repeat at different timestamps.

candidates.description: Authorized members, including those without any known local contribution.

coordinate.description: Protocol-owned canonical coordinate accepted by the requested operation.

reason.description: Optional UTF-8 reason, at most 1024 bytes without control characters. Cleared when unyanking.

filename.description: Exact filename; omit to update all visible files atomically.

publisher.description: Publisher actor of the most recent committed publish session for this coordinate. Empty when no publish session was recorded (for example replicated or pre-session artifacts).

buildNumber.description: Local publication sequence. Zero for releases; imported source timestamp and build number are exposed separately.

sourceTimestamp.description: Original timestamp of an imported Maven SNAPSHOT; absent for ordinary publications.

sourceBuildNumber.description: Original imported Maven SNAPSHOT build number, which can repeat at different timestamps.

publisher.description: Publisher actor of the most recent committed publish session for this reference. Empty when no publish session was recorded (for example replicated or pre-session artifacts).

_rev.description: Hosted package revision, required for metadata changes; never a tarball digest.

deprecated.description: Plain-text install warning, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; an empty string clears the warning.

OCIName.name: name
OCIName.description: OCI repository name. The gateway resolves slash-separated OCI names without decoding encoded separators.

NPMPackageName.name: package
NPMPackageName.description: npm package name; scoped names escape the separator as `@scope%2fname`.

helmPreviewIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
helmPreviewIdempotencyKey.description: Actor-scoped replay key. An expired publication reservation requires a new key; exact closure replay without a key is also safe.

ArtifactSearchMatch.name: match
ArtifactSearchMatch.description: Explicit coordinate matching. contains is a case-insensitive literal substring; prefix is a case-sensitive literal prefix. Omitting match preserves the legacy behavior of each format (Cargo name substring; other formats prefix). Complete SHA-256 queries in global search remain exact digest matches. Contains requests have a five-second server budget; narrow the query if it expires.

OCIImagePrefix.name: q
OCIImagePrefix.description: OCI image-name prefix used to filter the repository projection.

MavenCoordinatePrefix.name: q
MavenCoordinatePrefix.description: Maven coordinate prefix used to filter the committed-coordinate projection.

ConanReferencePrefix.name: q
ConanReferencePrefix.description: Conan recipe-reference prefix used to filter the visible-reference projection.

FormatProfileList.description: Supported artifact formats and management capabilities

OCIManifest.description: Committed OCI manifest, returned with Docker-Content-Digest

OCITagList.description: OCI tag list ordered lexicographically. A Link header with rel=next is returned when more tags are available.

RawDirectoryList.description: Lexicographically ordered Native Raw directory-prefix page

BasicUnauthorized.description: Native protocol Basic authentication required when anonymous read policy is disabled

ProtocolNotFound.description: No committed object is addressable at this protocol path

RepositoryCapacity.description: Logical repository capacity and configured quota

RetentionDryRun.description: Repository retention candidates without state changes

LifecycleJobList.description: Lifecycle jobs for one repository, newest first

Deletion.description: Accepted asynchronous deletion. The repository is immediately unavailable to protocol traffic and is finalized by the background deletion worker; audit metadata is retained.

AuditList.description: Administrative audit records, ordered newest first

OIDCSettings.description: Effective runtime OIDC authentication settings with credentials redacted

WebhookSubscription.description: Webhook subscription with signing secret redacted

RepositoryCapacityList.description: Logical capacity snapshots across all repositories

RepositoryLifecycleJobList.description: Lifecycle jobs across all repositories, newest first

RepositoryCapabilities.description: Operations supported by a Hosted repository format

RepositoryEffectiveAccess.description: Effective repository access decisions for the authenticated actor and anonymous read policy

OCIManifestSummaryList.description: Visible OCI manifests for one image, including untagged digests

RawBinaryObject.description: Committed Raw object with an optional readable save-as filename

Content-Disposition.description: Optional inline disposition carrying the decoded final path segment as filename.

conan.description: Official Conan 2.21.0 hash-revision upload and read workflow. Register /conan/{repository} as the remote root; the client appends /v1 or /v2. Hosted PUTs reuse durable publication sessions and immutable object intents. Only a complete validated manifest commits a recipe or package revision. Management publication uses the same validator, snapshot fence and atomic revision/session/audit commit; it cannot publish partial revisions. Group and Proxy remotes are read-only. The retired /conan/v2/{repository} layout is not an alias. Conan 1, SCM revisions and optional metadata uploads are unsupported. See docs/conan-native-publication.md for bounds and evidence.
